references.observed: Actually inspected 2016 elevated station/hotel overview: broad low concourse with deep flat parking-roof fascia and open supported edges; rooftop parking deck with pale rails; upper pale/gray-clad podium with recessed openings and exterior metal stair flights; several staggered hotel slabs above it with regular blue-gray window arrays, a broad mirrored short face, dark recessed wedge/slot and flat roofs/services. Preserve the attached hotel mass as part of the complete physical station ensemble. No copied hotel/rail brands,car fleet,public artworks,forecourt construction,plaza lettering or other nearby buildings.

references.observed: Actually inspected principal-entrance detail: broad dark recessed curtain wall beneath a deep pale cantilevered fascia,slender metal columns,large two-level glazing grid andmultiple closed entrance doors. Main upper hotel window grid remains visible. Exact sign text,logos,posters,people,luggage andshop brands are not source textures or required geometry. Unpictured rear andopposite-side entrance inventory needs coherent original interpretation.
